description: The tourist or short-term business visa requirements for a destination, from the table Mira reads: documents, processing time, fees and the official page they come from (source). They are general, not checked against a nationality: whether the person needs a visa at all is visarun_check_eligibility's answer. What a given application asks is in visarun_get_application_fields.

country.description: The destination, a name or ISO code
